output.summary: A robust herbaceous perennial native to Europe and Asia, including China, Japan, Kazakhstan, the Koreas, Mongolia, Siberia, Russia and Turkmenistan. It has aromatic, dark-green, deeply toothed leaves and small golden-yellow flowers in dense, flat-topped clusters in summer.
output.edibilityNote: Used to add aroma and bitterness to vermouth and in sweet and savoury dishes.
